svg.title: Architecture — AD Manager
svg.desc: Network diagram of the example.local domain. Administration from the browser, desktop app, CLI or MCP; panel with SQLite and Redis; two Samba AD controllers and two Samba servers, each with an smbd service for shares and a separate management agent. HTTPS 9443 connections from the panel to the agents, SMB 445 from the workstations to the smbd services, LDAPS, Kerberos and DNS, with migration from a Windows 2008 controller.
svg.text: example.local / identity, files and auditable access
